title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.59 (versions follow prime numbers), the cube and the sleep. Poetic code: the organ sentences that already work are promoted to a word, and with words a plateau is crossed that the one-letter search did not cross (organ 51638: 12628 against the champion's 11144). A living cube keeps every recipe by its three values (image, words, code), with melody, harmony and rest; its first melody found 5163827 (13175). It ate all the free code it was given, eleven books: 38516 pays in all eleven, and the champion of a single domain harms code. Luma has a fifth act, sleeping: she is born again with what is new. Stated failures: the new habit makes her sleep almost all the time at first, and there are no new senses yet (new letters built from random fragments of its own code: 0 of 19 paid). OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.59: el cubo y el sueño — código poético, un cubo vivo con melodía y armonía, y Luma que duerme cuando quiere. Prototipo de investigación.
